description: This file defines a widget for visualizing connectivity maps using networkx and matplotlib, including node management, graph layout, and interactive annotations.

classes.name: ConnectivityMapWidget
classes.description: A QWidget subclass that manages and visualizes a network connectivity graph with interactive features.

classes.name: UpdateSig
classes.description: A QObject subclass that provides a custom signal for graph updates.

methods.name: closeEvent
methods.description: Handles cleanup on widget close, disconnecting signals and closing plots.

methods.name: is_dfs_channel
methods.description: Checks if a given channel is a DFS channel.

methods.name: set_node_size_color_label
methods.description: Sets size, color, and label for a node based on its type and properties.

methods.name: update_hierarchies_from_node
methods.description: Recursively updates hierarchy levels of nodes starting from a given node.

methods.name: add_delta_x_from_node
methods.description: Recursively adds a delta to the x position of a node and its children.

methods.name: update_x_positions_from_node
methods.description: Calculates x positions for nodes based on hierarchy and connections.

methods.name: update_y_positions_from_node
methods.description: Calculates y positions for nodes based on hierarchy and node type.

methods.name: update_positions_from_node
methods.description: Updates both x and y positions for a node.

methods.name: update_graph
methods.description: Recomputes node positions, sizes, colors, and redraws the network graph.

methods.name: redraw_graph
methods.description: Clears and redraws the entire graph visualization.

methods.name: add_node_to_graph
methods.description: Adds or updates a node in the graph, including its edges and attributes.

methods.name: remove_node_by_mac
methods.description: Removes a node and its children from the graph based on MAC address.

methods.name: mac_plus_one
methods.description: Returns the MAC address incremented by one.

methods.name: onresize
methods.description: Handles resize events for the widget.

methods.name: set_in_frame
methods.description: Adjusts annotation position to stay within the plot frame.

methods.name: update_annot
methods.description: Updates annotation text and position for hovered nodes.

methods.name: hover
methods.description: Handles mouse hover events to show node annotations.

methods.name: readSample
methods.description: Parses input lines to update the graph with node and connection data.

methods.name: addConnMap
methods.description: Initializes the matplotlib figure and toolbar for the widget.

methods.name: sendSig
methods.description: Emits a signal to trigger graph redraw.

methods.name: updateWidthHeight
methods.description: Updates the widget's width and height based on figure size.

methods.name: increment_node_counters
methods.description: Increments 'last seen' counters for nodes and removes stale nodes.

methods.name: reset_last_seen
methods.description: Resets the 'last seen' counter for a node with a specific MAC.
